title: Zesty Molten Tunisian Lamb Tagine
description: A rich and flavorful Tunisian dish featuring tender lamb and a blend of aromatic spices, perfect for a hearty dinner or hangover cure.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the lamb pieces with onion salt, cumin, and smoked paprika.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb pieces until browned on all sides, then remove from the pot.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook until fragrant.
Add the chicken broth, diced tomatoes, and browned lamb to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a large rectangle.
Remove the pot from the oven and place the pastry on top, tucking the edges under the lamb.
Return the pot to the oven and bake for an additional 20 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
